trials.title: A Study in Participants With Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Amenable to Exon 45 Skipping to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of ENTR-601-45

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with Treatment Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs) according to study protocol (Part A and OL Period).

reasons: one of only 3 trials at this company
trials.commentary: Ph 1/Ph 2, randomized, double-blind. Targeting 24 patients. Started Aug 2025, primary completion Mar 2029. Record history not collected yet; comparisons are vs first seen.
